newsitem.title: UK: Suspect stowaway survives 10-hour Delhi-London flight.
newsitem.headline: Suspect stowaway survives 10-hour Delhi-London flight.

text.p: An Indian national found wandering around Heathrow airport was suspected of having stowed away in a plane's baggage hold on a 10-hour flight from New Delhi to London, British officials said on Sunday.
"He's lucky to be alive given...the temperature in the baggage hold of an aircraft flying at the heights it would fly to reach London from Delhi," an immigration official said.
A worker for British Airways found the unidentified man wandering in a restricted area near one of their aircraft at Heathrow airport, west of London on Saturday.
After being questioned by immigration officials he was treated for hypothermia at a local hospital.
"We believe he stowed away in the baggage hold of an aircraft that took him from Delhi to London," the immigration official told reporters.

British Airways, which operates many of the flights into terminal four, the area where the man was found, said they would be launching their own investgation into the incident which raises serious questions about airport security.
"It is not known at this stage what airline he travelled with. Pending further information from immigration we will launch our own inquiry," BA spokeswoman Laura Devere said.
The stowaway, whom officials refused to identify is being held at a local detention centre.
"He has sought leave to remain in the UK. While his application for leave to remain is being considered he will remain in detention," the immigration official added.
